name: rsk_getRawTransactionReceiptByHash
summary: Returns the RLP-encoded receipt of the given transaction.
description: Returns the receipt exactly as it is encoded into the receipts trie, so it can be verified against a block header. Only transactions on the main chain are considered; anything else returns `null`.

result.name: rawTransactionReceipt
result.description: The RLP-encoded transaction receipt, or `null` if the transaction is not on the main chain

examples.name: getRawTransactionReceiptByHashExample
examples.description: The result is abridged; a real encoded receipt also carries the bloom filter and the logs
